dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Smooth, symmetrical convergence of the lateral margins from the maximal width of the mid-body toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins exhibit a smooth, continuous curvature without visible bulges or indentations.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white with high-intensity reflectance; median pixel values represent a fully depigmented epidermal state.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A distinct, dark, circular high-contrast point is visible at the blowhole region; a sharp, dark linear mark is present on the posterior midline.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A deep, shadow-casting longitudinal indentation is centered on the dorsal axis in the posterior third of the visible body.

other_distinctive_markers: Exceptionally pronounced and elongated dorsal ridge crease.
